maths: Why was the equal sign so calm? It knew both sides were balanced.
Why did the fraction visit the gym? It wanted to get into its simplest form.
Why did the angle bring a blanket? It was below ninety degrees.
books: Why did the book wear a jacket? Its story was a little chilly.
Why was the library so tall? It had lots of stories.
Why did the bookmark get promoted? It always knew its place.
space: Why did the astronaut bring a pencil? To draw some space.
Why was the Moon invited to dinner? It brought a little atmosphere—actually, it forgot that bit!
How do planets organise a party? They planet.
animals: What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear.
Why did the duck bring a notebook? To practise its quack-ulations.
Why was the owl good at revision? It always asked who, what and why.
food: Why did the biscuit visit the nurse? It felt a little crumbly.
What did the grape say when it got stepped on? Nothing—it let out a little wine.
Why was the mushroom invited? It was a fun guy.
school: Why did the pencil take a break? It needed to draw breath.
Why did the ruler join the band? It had perfect measures.
Why did the exercise book smile? It had turned over a new leaf.
computers: Why did the computer wear glasses? To improve its web sight.
Why did the keyboard need a holiday? It had lost its space.
Why was the mouse quiet? It did not want to click with everyone.
sport: Why did the footballer bring string? To tie the score.
Why was the stadium cool? It was full of fans.
Why did the runner bring a pencil? To draw level.
weather: What does a cloud wear under its coat? Thunderwear.
Why did the sun go to school? To get a little brighter.
Why did the snowflake take a break? It was snowed under.
music: Why did the musician bring a ladder? To reach the high notes.
Why did the drum bring an umbrella? It expected a heavy beat.
Why was the piano polite? It knew when to use its soft voice.
history: Why did the historian bring a ladder? To look into the past from a higher level.
Why was the castle good at chess? It had two rooks.
Why did the archaeologist love jokes? They dug the old ones.
geography: Why did the map look happy? It had found its direction.
Why did the river take its time? It wanted to go with the flow.
Why did the mountain finish its homework? It wanted to reach its peak.
anything: Why did the calendar look proud? Its days were numbered.
What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore.
Why did the bicycle take a nap? It was two-tyred.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? It was outstanding in its field.
